description: The whole Canvas REST API in one Go binary — plus a local store, offline search, and cross-resource commands (roster, at-risk, standings) that no single Canvas endpoint returns.

novel_features.name: Unified roster
novel_features.description: One table of every student in a course with section, login/SIS ID, role, current and final score, and missing-work count.

novel_features.name: At-risk / missing radar
novel_features.description: Ranked list of students with missing, late, or unsubmitted work across one or all of an instructor's courses, time-windowed.

novel_features.name: Grading queue
novel_features.description: A single oldest-first queue of every submitted-but-ungraded item across the instructor's courses, with student, assignment, and points.

novel_features.name: Since-window changelog
novel_features.description: A 'what changed' digest of new submissions, new announcements, and new enrollments since a time window.

novel_features.name: Cross-course standings
novel_features.description: Grade-distribution and pass/fail/DFW rollups computed locally across every course in a term, drillable by section or course.

novel_features.name: Enrollment audit
novel_features.description: Flags enrollment anomalies in an account: students with no submissions, teacher-less courses, and concluded-but-active users.
